user.title: Add pool
user.description: Set up a pool and select the switch that controls the pump.

abort.already_configured: This pump is already configured for another pool.

add_window.title: Add time window
add_window.description: The pump is switched on at the start and off at the end. If the end is earlier than the start, the window runs past midnight. The days refer to the day the window starts.

dry_run.title: Dry-run detection
dry_run.description: Detects a pump running dry: the pump is on and the power stays between the lower and upper limit for the set duration. Without a power sensor the feature is off. An alarm stays until acknowledged or the pump is restarted.

data.dry_auto_off: Switch the pump off on dry run and pause the schedule

data_description.dry_auto_off: The schedule is only re-enabled after acknowledging (button).

error.too_many_windows: Maximum number of time windows reached.
error.min_ge_max: The lower limit must be below the upper limit.

run_pump.name: Run pump
run_pump.description: Runs the pump for a set time, independent of the schedule.

entry_id.name: Pool (config entry ID)
entry_id.description: Optional. Without it, all pools are affected.
